items.title: S&P 500 Breaches Record Territory as Federal Reserve Signals Measured Easing Path
items.content_text: Benchmark US equities pushed into historic highs on Monday as Wall Street digested dovish FOMC commentary, cooling PCE inflation prints, and expanding capital expenditure across cloud infrastructure. Over 74% of S&P 500 constituents are currently trading above their 200-day moving average.
items.summary: Benchmark US equities pushed into historic highs on Monday as Wall Street digested dovish FOMC commentary and robust consumer discretionary balance sheets.

items.title: NVIDIA Extends AI Hardware Dominance as Hyperscale Capex Forecasts Expand
items.content_text: NVIDIA shares gained over 3.6% after tier-one cloud providers upgraded their cumulative 2026-2027 AI compute budgets, solidifying Blackwell architecture demand. TSMC packaging yields for CoWoS-L have stabilized ahead of schedule.
items.summary: NVIDIA shares gained over 3.6% after tier-one cloud providers upgraded their cumulative 2026-2027 AI compute budgets, solidifying Blackwell architecture demand.

items.title: Bitcoin Surges Past Key Resistance as Spot ETFs Absorb Record Weekly Inflows
items.content_text: Institutional net inflows into spot Bitcoin ETFs crossed $2.1 billion last week, pushing BTC above the $65,000 threshold with surging open interest. Exchange-traded fund reserves have reached an all-time high of over 1.05 million BTC.
items.summary: Institutional net inflows into spot Bitcoin ETFs crossed $2.1 billion last week, pushing BTC above the $65,000 threshold with surging open interest.
